lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns. A prominent central column features four distinct, large centroids, while smaller, more densely packed clusters are visible moving anteriorly towards the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, creating a visible grid-like pattern where the bands intersect the high-intensity circular nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the mid-lateral flank, characterized by a light-to-dark vertical luminance gradient (highlight on the superior edge, shadow on the inferior edge).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several thin, pale linear markings (potential abrasions or scars) are visible on the flank superior to the pectoral fin attachment point. A darker, vertical indentation is visible just posterior to the final gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) visible beneath the ventral-lateral margin and trailing the pectoral fin.
